items.name: ImagenMIA
items.description: AI-Powered Professional Photos from Your Selfies
items.long_description:
ImagenMIA is an AI-driven platform based in Belgium that transforms ordinary selfies into professional-quality photographs in minutes, eliminating the need for traditional photoshoots. Founded by Fekri (known online as @fekdaoui), the service is tailored for users seeking polished headshots and creative profile images for a wide range of digital platforms.

How ImagenMIA Works
Users upload between 6 and 12 high-quality photos, ideally including a mix of close-ups, side profiles, upper body, and full-body shots. The more diverse the input (expressions, angles, backgrounds), the better the results.

ImagenMIA’s AI model is trained on these images to generate new photos in over 100 different styles, including:

Corporate headshots (ideal for LinkedIn or CVs);
Artistic and anime-inspired portraits;
Gaming and “gangster” styles;
Aesthetic and shareable profile photos for social media, dating profiles, and more;
The platform delivers studio-quality images within minutes, offering instant downloads and the flexibility to use the results anywhere — social media, websites, business cards, and beyond.
Privacy and Data Handling
Data is stored securely on servers in Europe with trusted third-party partners.
Uploaded photos and trained AI models are deleted within 30 days, or users can request instant deletion. ImagenMIA emphasizes privacy and does not sell user data, setting it apart from some competitors.
Payments are processed securely via LemonSqueezy, and users can request invoices for their purchases.
Pricing
ImagenMIA offers a one-time payment model, with prices ranging from $17.79 to $37.79 depending on the selected package.
Refunds are available within 14 days if the AI has not yet been trained on the user’s photos.
Key Features
Over 100 style packs for various professional and creative needs;
No need for expensive or time-consuming photoshoots;
Fast turnaround — professional photos in minutes;
Strong privacy guarantees (no data resale, prompt deletion);
Easy-to-use interface, even for those with no technical background.
Why Choose ImagenMIA?
ImagenMIA stands out for users who want a straightforward, privacy-focused solution for professional photos without hidden data practices or ongoing subscriptions. Its range of styles and focus on quick, high-quality output make it ideal for professionals, job seekers, and anyone looking to enhance their digital presence with minimal hassle.

For those seeking more advanced creative features like video clips, virtual try-ons, or batch processing for multiple models, PhotoAI might be a better fit, albeit at a higher price point and with less explicit privacy guarantees.

Final Thoughts
ImagenMIA offers a user-friendly, secure, and affordable way to create professional-grade photos from the comfort of home. With transparent pricing, robust privacy protections, and a variety of styles, it’s a compelling choice for anyone needing polished images for personal or professional use.
